# Composite actions

<link-summary>Inputs and outputs of every composite action of davils-com/workflows.</link-summary>

The reusable workflows are built from these actions. Custom workflows can use them directly:

```yaml
- uses: davils-com/workflows/actions/setup-dart-env@v1
```

## android-signing

Writes the upload keystore of an Android app from a base64 secret and an android/key.properties that points to it. The app's android/app/build.gradle(.kts) reads key.properties for its release signing config, as in the Flutter deployment guide. Nothing is written when the keystore is empty.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `app-directory` (required) |  | Directory of the Flutter app, relative to the repository root. |
| `keystore-base64` | empty | The keystore (JKS or PKCS12), base64 encoded. |
| `keystore-password` | empty | Password of the keystore. |
| `key-alias` | empty | Alias of the upload key. |
| `key-password` | empty | Password of the upload key; empty uses the keystore password. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `signed` | true when a keystore was written. |

## apple-signing

Imports a signing certificate into a temporary keychain and installs provisioning profiles, for signed iOS and macOS builds. Delete the keychain at the end of the job with security delete-keychain on the keychain output (in an if always() step); composite actions have no post step. Nothing happens when the certificate is empty.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `certificate-p12-base64` | empty | The signing certificate with its private key (PKCS12), base64 encoded. |
| `certificate-password` | empty | Password of the PKCS12 file. |
| `provisioning-profiles-base64` | empty | Provisioning profiles, each base64 encoded, one per line. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `signed` | true when a certificate was imported. |
| `keychain` | Path of the temporary keychain. |

## build-matrix

Builds a job matrix from discovered packages: one job per package, one for all, or the packages spread over shards, each times SDKs and operating systems. A job with an empty matrix fails, so check the count before using the matrix.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `discovery` (required) |  | Output of discover-packages. |
| `affected` | empty | The affected output of discover-packages; empty uses every package. |
| `toolchain` | `all` | dart, flutter or all. |
| `select` | `all` | all, tests, publishable, apps, executables or inspectra. |
| `sdks` | `["stable"]` | JSON array of SDKs (stable, beta, lowest or a version; Flutter versions for flutter). |
| `os` | `["ubuntu"]` | JSON array of operating systems (ubuntu, ubuntu-arm, macos, windows, windows-arm). |
| `extra-os-sdk` | `first` | first (other operating systems only get the first SDK) or all. |
| `granularity` | `auto` | auto, package, workspace or shards. |
| `shards` | `8` | Number of shards. |
| `shard-threshold` | `20` | Package count from which auto shards. |
| `runners` | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels (linux, linux-arm, macos, windows, windows-arm). |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `matrix` | The matrix as JSON ({"include":[...]}); every entry has id, label, packages, paths, workspace, os, runner, sdk, sdk_label and primary. |
| `count` | The number of matrix entries. |
| `packages` | Every selected package, as a JSON array. |
| `package-count` | The number of selected packages. |

## coverage-collect

Merges the lcov files of several packages, writes the coverage per package to the job summary, enforces a minimum and renders an HTML report.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `input-directory` (required) |  | Directory with <package>.lcov files. |
| `output-directory` | empty | Directory for lcov.info, summary.md and html/. |
| `min` | `0` | Minimum total line coverage in percent; 0 disables the check. |
| `html` | `false` | Render an HTML report with genhtml. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `percent` | The total line coverage in percent; empty when nothing was collected. |
| `lcov` | Path of the merged lcov.info. |
| `output-directory` | The output directory. |

## discover-packages

Finds the Dart and Flutter packages of a repository (pub workspace members, nested or globbed, and packages outside the workspace) and narrows them to the ones a change affects. build-matrix turns the result into a job matrix.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `include` | empty | Globs of further package directories, for packages outside the workspace (newline or comma separated, or a JSON array). |
| `exclude` | empty | Globs of package directories to leave out. |
| `external-path-dependencies` | `error` | error or warn, for path dependencies that leave the repository. |
| `affected-only` | `auto` | true, false or auto (auto narrows pull requests and merge groups to the affected packages). |
| `base-sha` | empty | The commit to compare with for affected-only. Empty means every package. |
| `always-all-paths` | `pubspec.yaml\npubspec.lock\nanalysis_options.yaml\ndart_test.yaml\ninspectra.yaml\ninspectra.base.yaml\ntrivy*.yaml\ntool/**\n.github/**` | Globs relative to the working directory; a change to one of them affects every package. |
| `discovery` | empty | A discovery computed before (pipeline.yml passes its own); skips the discovery. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `discovery` | Every package with its metadata, as JSON. |
| `affected` | The affected packages and the changed files, as JSON. |

## inspectra-run

Runs an Inspectra command and turns its exit code into a clear annotation: findings, usage error, invalid configuration, incomplete run (optionally only a warning) or internal error.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `command` (required) |  | The command that runs Inspectra (the command output of inspectra-setup). |
| `args` (required) |  | The arguments, such as -C packages/core check. Split on whitespace. |
| `label` | `check` | Name of the run in annotations. |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory to run in, relative to the repository root. |
| `tolerate-incomplete` | `false` | Turn exit code 69 (a service or tool was unavailable) into a warning. |
| `config-file` | empty | Sets INSPECTRA_CONFIG. |
| `profile` | empty | Sets INSPECTRA_PROFILE. |

## inspectra-scan

Runs inspectra scan (OSV audit, pubspec rules, typosquatting, Trivy filesystem scan) once for GitHub code scanning (SARIF, never failing) and once as the gate, whose Markdown report goes to the job summary.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `command` (required) |  | The command that runs Inspectra (the command output of inspectra-setup). |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory to scan, relative to the repository root. |
| `recursive` | `true` | Also scan nested packages (pub workspaces and monorepos). |
| `fail-on` | empty | Empty keeps fail_on of the Inspectra configuration; critical, high, medium, low, unknown, or none to never fail. |
| `min-severity` | empty | Hide findings below this severity. |
| `trivy-mode` | empty | auto, required or disabled; empty keeps the configuration. |
| `trivy-version` | empty | Trivy version; empty keeps the configuration. |
| `offline` | `false` | Never open a network connection. |
| `sarif` | `true` | Upload the findings to GitHub code scanning (needs security-events write). |
| `sarif-category` | `inspectra` | Category of the SARIF upload. |
| `summary` | `true` | Write the Markdown report to the job summary. |
| `tolerate-incomplete` | `false` | Turn exit code 69 into a warning. |
| `config-file` | empty | Sets INSPECTRA_CONFIG. |
| `profile` | empty | Sets INSPECTRA_PROFILE. |
| `args` | empty | Extra arguments for inspectra scan. |

## inspectra-setup

Makes Inspectra available (the dev dependency of the project, a global activation or the checksum-verified native binary of a release), restores the Trivy database cache and, when asked, provisions Trivy on the PATH for build_runner builders with run_on_build.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `install` | `auto` | auto (dev-dependency when the root pubspec.yaml depends on inspectra, global otherwise), dev-dependency, global or binary. |
| `version` | `latest` | latest or a version such as 2.1.0, for global and binary. |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `trivy-cache` | `true` | Restore and save the Trivy vulnerability database (~/.cache/trivy). |
| `trivy-on-path` | `false` | Provision Trivy with inspectra trivy --install and put it on the PATH of later steps. |
| `binary-repository` | `davils-com/Inspectra` | Repository of the native binaries. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `command` | The command that runs Inspectra, such as dart run inspectra. |
| `mode` | The install mode used. |

## pages-assemble

Downloads every davils-pages-* artifact of the run (Writerside docs, API docs, Flutter web builds, coverage and quality reports), places each at its path of the layout, rewrites the base href of Flutter web builds, adds a landing page and uploads the site for actions/deploy-pages.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `layout` | `{"docs":"/","api":"/api","web":"/app/{id}","coverage":"/coverage/{id}","inspectra":"/quality"}` | JSON object mapping a part (docs, api, web, coverage, inspectra) to its path; {id} is the id of the part. |
| `base-path` | empty | Base path of the site (the base_path output of actions/configure-pages). |
| `landing-page` | `auto` | auto (when no part provides /index.html), true or false. |
| `cname` | empty | Custom domain of the site. |
| `spa-fallback` | empty | Id of a web part whose index.html also serves as 404.html, for client side routing. |
| `extra-path` | empty | Directory of the repository copied into the site root. |
| `title` | empty | Title of the landing page. |
| `artifact-pattern` | `davils-pages-*` | Pattern of the artifacts with parts. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `parts` | The placed parts, as JSON. |

## plan-builds

Plans build jobs from discovered packages: every Flutter app times its enabled targets, or every Dart executable times its targets, each with the runner the target needs.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` (required) |  | flutter or dart-compile. |
| `discovery` (required) |  | Output of discover-packages. |
| `targets` | empty | flutter, a JSON object target -> true/false/auto; dart-compile, a JSON array of targets. |
| `apps` | empty | flutter, a JSON array of app package names; empty means every app. |
| `executables` | empty | dart-compile, a JSON array of {package, entrypoint, name}; empty means every executable of the pubspec.yaml files. |
| `runners` | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `matrix` | The matrix as JSON. |
| `count` | The number of build jobs. |

## release-notes

Writes the release notes of a version: from inspectra changelog notes, from the version's section of CHANGELOG.md, from a file, or leaves them to GitHub's generated notes.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | `auto` | auto, inspectra, changelog, file, generate or keep. |
| `package-path` | `.` | Directory of the package, relative to the working directory. |
| `version` (required) |  | The released version. |
| `file` | empty | For source file, the path relative to the working directory. |
| `inspectra-command` | empty | The command that runs Inspectra, for source inspectra and auto. |
| `has-inspectra` | `false` | true when the package has an Inspectra configuration. |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `file` | Path of the notes file. |
| `source` | The source that was used. |

## resolve-config

Merges the defaults, a preset, .github/davils-ci.yaml, inline configuration and typed overrides, validates the result, discovers the packages and decides which features run for this event.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `config-file` | empty | Path of the configuration file relative to the repository root. Empty means .github/davils-ci.yaml when it exists; none ignores any file. |
| `config` | empty | Inline configuration as YAML or JSON; it wins over the file. |
| `preset` | empty | library, workspace, flutter-app, cli or docs; applied below the file. |
| `overrides` | `{}` | JSON object of options that win over everything else (pipeline.yml builds it from its typed inputs). |
| `working-directory` | empty | Overrides project.working-directory. |
| `validate` | `true` | Fail on unknown options and wrong types. |
| `base-sha` | empty | The commit to compare with for affected packages and path filters. |
| `base-ref` | empty | The target branch of a pull request or merge group. |
| `is-fork` | `false` | true when the event comes from a fork; SARIF uploads and checks are then skipped. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `config` | The resolved configuration as JSON; every auto toggle is true or false. |
| `run` | JSON object telling which features run for this event. |
| `event` | JSON object with the event, the branch and a parsed release tag. |
| `discovery` | Every package with its metadata, as JSON. |
| `affected` | The affected packages and the changed files, as JSON. |
| `working-directory` | The resolved working directory. |

## run-hook

Runs shell commands of the consumer repository at a fixed point of a job. The commands arrive through an environment variable, never through an expression, and do nothing when empty.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `run` | empty | The shell commands. |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory the commands run in, relative to the repository root. |
| `name` | `hook` | Name of the hook, for the log. |

## setup-dart-env

Installs a Dart SDK (stable, beta, dev or a version), restores the pub cache, signs in to a private package host and private git hosts when tokens are given, and resolves the dependencies of the packages (once at the workspace root for workspace members).

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sdk` | `stable` | stable, beta, dev, main or a version such as 3.13.5. |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `packages` | empty | JSON array of packages ({path, workspace}) whose dependencies to resolve; empty resolves the working directory only. |
| `resolve` | `true` | Run dart pub get. |
| `pub-get-args` | empty | Extra arguments for dart pub get, such as --enforce-lockfile. |
| `cache` | `true` | Restore and save the pub cache. |
| `pub-hosted-url` | empty | URL of a private package host. |
| `pub-hosted-token` | empty | Token of the private package host. |
| `git-token` | empty | Token for git dependencies on private repositories. |
| `git-host` | `github.com` | Host of the private git repositories. |
| `post-setup` | empty | Shell commands run after the dependencies are resolved. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `dart-version` | The installed Dart version. |

## setup-flutter-env

Installs a Flutter SDK (a channel, a version or the version of a file such as .fvmrc or pubspec.yaml), the Linux desktop build dependencies and Java when asked, restores the pub cache and resolves the dependencies of the packages.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | `stable` | stable, beta, main, any or a version such as 3.47.7. A channel name installs its latest release. |
| `version-file` | empty | A file to read the Flutter version from (pubspec.yaml or .fvmrc); wins over version. |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `packages` | empty | JSON array of packages ({path, workspace}) whose dependencies to resolve; empty resolves the working directory only. |
| `resolve` | `true` | Run flutter pub get. |
| `pub-get-args` | empty | Extra arguments for flutter pub get. |
| `cache` | `true` | Cache the SDK and the pub cache. |
| `linux-desktop` | `false` | Install the packages flutter build linux needs (Linux runners only). |
| `java-version` | empty | Java version to install for Android builds; empty installs none. |
| `pub-hosted-url` | empty | URL of a private package host. |
| `pub-hosted-token` | empty | Token of the private package host. |
| `git-token` | empty | Token for git dependencies on private repositories. |
| `git-host` | `github.com` | Host of the private git repositories. |
| `post-setup` | empty | Shell commands run after the dependencies are resolved. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `flutter-version` | The installed Flutter version. |
| `dart-version` | The Dart version of the installed Flutter. |

## test-packages

Runs the tests of several Dart or Flutter packages, on the given platforms and compilers, collects their coverage with repository relative paths and their JSON test reports. A failing package does not stop the others.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tool` | `dart` | dart or flutter. |
| `packages` (required) |  | JSON array of packages ({name, path, has_tests}), paths relative to the working directory. |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `platforms` | empty | JSON array for dart test (vm, chrome, chrome:dart2wasm, ...); empty uses dart_test.yaml. |
| `command` | empty | Replaces the test command; runs in each package directory with PACKAGE_NAME and PACKAGE_PATH set. |
| `args` | empty | Extra arguments for the test command. |
| `exclude-tags` | empty | Tags to skip. |
| `coverage` | `false` | Collect coverage. |
| `coverage-source` | `auto` | auto, dart-ci, flutter-ci, inspectra or none. |
| `inspectra-enabled` | `false` | true when the inspectra workflow runs in the same pipeline. |
| `report` | `false` | Write JSON test reports. |
| `output-directory` | empty | Where coverage (coverage/<package>.lcov) and reports (reports/<package>.json) are collected. |
| `pre-test` | empty | Shell commands run before the tests. |
| `post-test` | empty | Shell commands run after the tests, also when they failed. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `output-directory` | The directory with coverage/ and reports/. |

## version-verify

Checks that a release tag matches a tag pattern, names a package of the repository, carries the version of its pubspec.yaml and points to a commit of the release branch. Needs a checkout with the history (fetch-depth 0) for the branch check.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tag` | empty | The tag; empty takes github.ref_name. |
| `tag-patterns` | `{"single":"v{version}","package":"{package}-v{version}"}` | JSON object of tag patterns with {package} and {version}. |
| `discovery` (required) |  | Output of discover-packages. |
| `release-branch` | `main` | Branch the tagged commit has to be on; empty skips the check. |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `package` | Name of the released package. |
| `path` | Path of the package, relative to the working directory. |
| `version` | The released version. |
| `prerelease` | true for a version with a pre-release part, such as 1.0.0-beta.1. |
| `release` | Everything about the release as JSON. |

## wait-for-pub-dev

Waits until the lowest version of every sibling package (a package of the same repository) that a package depends on is on pub.dev, so the packages of a workspace can be released together.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `package-path` (required) |  | Directory of the package, relative to the repository root. |
| `siblings` (required) |  | JSON array of the names of the packages of the repository. |
| `attempts` | `60` | How often to ask pub.dev. |
| `interval` | `30` | Seconds between two attempts. |
| `pub-url` | `https://pub.dev` | The package host. |

## writerside-build

Builds a Writerside instance with JetBrains' builder image (helpbuilderinspect), the same build the official action runs, without depending on that action's JavaScript runtime. Writes the web help archive, report.json and, when asked, the PDF and the Algolia indexes to artifacts/.

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `instance` (required) |  | Module directory and instance id, such as docs/d. |
| `location` | `.` | Directory of the Writerside module's parent, relative to the repository root. |
| `builder` | `docker` | docker (the builder image directly) or action (JetBrains/writerside-github-action). |
| `image` | `jetbrains/writerside-builder` | The builder image without tag. |
| `version` | `2026.09.0357` | Tag of the builder image. |
| `pdf` | empty | Name of a PDF export settings file (such as PDF.xml) to also build a PDF. |
| `is-group` | `false` | Build a group of instances. |

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `artifact` | File name of the web help archive in artifacts/. |
| `algolia-artifact` | File name of the Algolia index archive in artifacts/. |
| `id` | The instance id. |
| `directory` | The artifacts directory, relative to the repository root. |
